description: This Kotlin source file defines the HeroMetricsPresenter class, which is responsible for creating a visual hero card widget that displays three circular gauges and a mini bar strip, representing various fitness metrics. It extends the Android Leanback Presenter class and handles drawing custom graphics onto a Bitmap for display in an ImageCardView.

classes.name: HeroMetricsPresenter
classes.description: A Presenter subclass that creates and binds a hero dashboard card visualizing fitness metrics with gauges and a bar strip.

classes.name: HeroData
classes.description: A data class encapsulating fitness metrics: activePercent, alerts, energyPercent, and a list of recent ProgressEntry items.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and configures the view holder containing an ImageCardView for displaying the metric visualization.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Draws the gauges and bar strip based on HeroData onto a Bitmap and sets it as the main image of the card.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Clears the image bitmap when unbinding the view holder.
